description: Focused GDD scenario fixtures for steering retention and post-merge continuation.

scenarios.title: Post-merge continuation must preserve decisions without committing raw task steering
scenarios.goal: PR merge 後に raw task steering を main へ混ぜず、必要な判断だけを永続化して新 worktree で次フェーズへ進む
scenarios.prompt: A GDD PR was merged. The old worktree still has .steering/<task>/ files and the next stage needs the approved decisions. The repo may or may not already track docs/learned-patterns.md.
must_preserve: repo-level learned-patterns is not raw task steering
merge follow-up order is read-only verification -> persistence -> cleanup -> new worktree
cleanup unsafe does not block creation of the next worktree
task branch may temporarily commit raw task steering for handoff only when needed, but PR/main must be net-zero
temporary raw steering push leaves branch history risk and requires squash merge plus branch delete
must_not_happen: create docs/learned-patterns.md in a repo that has not adopted it
reuse the old implementation worktree for the next stage
delete a dirty or ambiguous worktree
contract_snapshot: main には raw task .steering/<task>/ を含めない
repo-level learned-patterns (docs/learned-patterns.md) の採用済み判定は tracked on origin/<default-branch> or .gdd-config.md / repo docs
standard order: read-only verification -> persistence -> cleanup -> new worktree
branch-only transfer: temporary task branch commit is exception-only, then git rm before PR/main
branch history risk: squash merge and delete handoff branch
cleanup unsafe: keep old worktree and continue from a new worktree
expected_outcome: assistant explains raw task steering and repo-level learned-patterns separately
assistant persists decisions to ADR or adopted learned-patterns before cleanup
assistant starts next implementation from latest default branch in a new worktree
assistant keeps unsafe old worktree instead of deleting it
failure_modes: raw steering を main に commit する
古い worktree で次実装を始める

checklist.description: Raw task steering and repo-level learned-patterns are separated.
patterns: raw task steering ではない

checklist.description: Raw task steering is not committed to main.
patterns: main には raw task `.steering/<task>/` を含めない
PR / main の commit 対象にしない

checklist.description: Branch-only transfer allows only necessary task branch handoff and requires removal before PR/main.
Branch-only transfer warns about branch history risk and cleanup expectations.
Learned-patterns adoption is explicit and does not create .steering blindly.
patterns: 新規に `docs/learned-patterns.md` を作らない

checklist.description: Post-merge order and unsafe cleanup behavior are explicit.
patterns: read-only verification → persistence → cleanup → new worktree
